name: Hyperbeat USDT
oneLiner: hbUSDT is Hyperbeat's yield-bearing USDT vault token on HyperEVM, exposing holders to DeFi lending and strategy returns over Tether's underlying par.
collateral: USDT0 was the only enabled deposit token at the fixed HyperEVM review block; Hyperbeat's documentation also lists USDe and USR as broader or legacy vault inputs. Deposits enter a dynamic HyperEVM DeFi strategy allocation, so the current constituent mix is not represented by fixed authored weights. Direct USDT is not an accepted deposit asset.
pegMechanism: hbUSDT is a yield-bearing vault token over USDT strategy exposure; holders exit through Hyperbeat vault liquidity into USDT, while ultimate fiat par exit remains Tether's issuer route

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Hyperbeat documentation and Accountable transparency identify a dynamic yield strategy, but do not provide the complete inputs needed to assign a direct wrapper archetype. The tracked hbUSDT proxy was created in HyperEVM block 3270801 on 2025-05-02, which establishes its implementation boundary without overriding the inherited parent classification.

proofOfReserves.provider: Accountable (dashboard origin returned persistent HTTP 503 across 5+ checks on 2026-08-08 - an AWS ELB backend outage, not an edge blip; re-verify availability next sweep)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: hbUSDT is a Midas-built vault share (contract hbUSDT extends mTBILL) whose mint() is gated by HB_USDT_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE on MidasAccessControl. The sole role holder is Hyperbeat's permissionless Depositor: any user can call deposit() with an enabled deposit token and the Depositor mints shares at the pricer rate. depositCap is 0, which disables the cap check entirely, so user minting is currently unbounded. A 3/5 Hyperbeat Safe controls the Depositor through a Solmate RolesAuthority and can set the deposit cap, swap the pricer, pause deposits, and change accepted tokens. A single Midas EOA holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on MidasAccessControl and can grant HB_USDT_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE to any address. Token upgrades run through a Midas ProxyAdmin owned by a 2-day OpenZeppelin timelock.

controls.label: Hyperbeat hbUSDT Depositor (user deposit mint)
controls.capDescription: Depositor.depositCap() returns 0 at block 40439370; the verified source only enforces a cap when depositCap > 0, so hbUSDT minting through deposit() is uncapped. Only the Hyperbeat admin Safe can set or raise the cap.
controls.evidence: At HyperEVM block 40439370 (eth_call, https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm): MidasAccessControl 0x0312a9d1ff2372ddedcbb21e4b6389afc919ac4b hasRole(keccak(HB_USDT_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE)=0x4708f1ddf76bb2ba71756e83ce9cafa1a90b46a12e0e8a4dd2ecdc08032c845b, 0x6261f301...) = true; it is the only holder. Hyperscan-verified source (contract Depositor) shows deposit(address,address,uint256,bytes32) is external with no auth modifier and calls VaultToken(vaultToken).mint(_receiver, vaultTokenAmount); vaultToken() = 0x5e105266db42f78fa814322bce7f388b4c2e61eb, isPaused() = false, depositCap() = 0, depositFee() = 0, isDepositToken(USDT0) = true. owner() = 0x0 (renounced); all admin functions are requiresAuth through the RolesAuthority.

controls.label: Hyperbeat vault admin Safe
controls.capDescription: Sole authorized caller of Depositor.setDepositCap; can also swap the pricer that sets shares-per-deposit, pause deposits, and toggle accepted deposit tokens.
controls.evidence: At HyperEVM block 40439370: Depositor.authority() = RolesAuthority 0x6278d7d6e57db17d002bc9b13e3284f58d05099a, whose owner() = 0x582195604f449df55219d707e0b4f9bdb3095b65. That address is a Safe v1.4.1 (VERSION() = 1.4.1, getThreshold() = 3, getOwners() = 5 owners, getModulesPaginated = empty, guard slot = 0x0, masterCopy slot0 = 0x29fcb43b46531bca003ddc8fcb67ffe91900c762). RolesAuthority.canCall(Safe, Depositor, sig) = true for setDepositCap(uint256), togglePaused(), setPricer(address), and toggleDepositToken(address,bool); eth_call of setDepositCap from the Safe succeeds while the same call from the Midas admin EOA, the two role-holding ops addresses, and a random address all revert with UNAUTHORIZED. The Safe cannot mint hbUSDT directly and holds no MidasAccessControl mint role.

controls.label: Midas HyperEVM access-control admin EOA
controls.capDescription: Can grant HB_USDT_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE to any address with no cap or delay; cannot set the Depositor's deposit cap.
controls.evidence: At HyperEVM block 40439370: MidasAccessControl.hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xd4195cf4df289a4748c1a7b6ddbe770e27ba1227) = true (negative control 0x...dEaD returns false), and eth_getCode returns empty, so it is an EOA. getRoleAdmin(HB_USDT_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE) = 0x00..00 (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE), so this EOA can grant or revoke the mint role immediately. Hyperscan RoleGranted history shows it as the sender of every HB_USDT role grant. Deployer 0xa0819ae43115420beb161193b8d8ba64c9f9facc no longer holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (hasRole = false).

controls.label: Midas HyperEVM ProxyAdmin timelock
controls.capDescription: Owns the ProxyAdmin that can replace the hbUSDT implementation, and therefore its mint logic, after a two-day delay.

sources.label: hbUSDT token proxy and verified implementation (Hyperscan)

controls.evidence: At HyperEVM block 40439370: hbUSDT EIP-1967 admin slot (0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103) = ProxyAdmin 0xbf25b58cb8dfad688f7bcb2b87d71c23a6600aac; ProxyAdmin.owner() = 0x76613bddb3d89393b4bd70d6894b1c85f6c37d5f. That contract is an OpenZeppelin TimelockController: getMinDelay() = 172800 (2 days), and PROPOSER_ROLE(), EXECUTOR_ROLE(), CANCELLER_ROLE(), TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE() all return the standard OZ hashes. This resolves the previously unresolved owner contract flagged in the 2026-06-11 review.

controls.label: Retired Midas hbUSDT deposit vault
controls.evidence: The Midas DepositVault at 0xbE8A4f1a312b94A712F8E5367B02ae6E378E6F19 (mToken() = hbUSDT) minted every hbUSDT Transfer-from-zero observed up to block ~12.8M via depositInstant. At block 40439370 it is paused() = true and MidasAccessControl.hasRole(HB_USDT_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE, vault) = false, so it can no longer mint; the mint role moved to the Hyperbeat Depositor at block 22639928. Hyperbeat docs still list this address as the deposit contract.

review.evidence: Full control graph resolved on HyperEVM at block 40439370 via eth_call, eth_getStorageAt, and eth_getCode against https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm, plus Hyperscan-verified sources for hbUSDT (contract hbUSDT is mTBILL) and the Hyperbeat Depositor. Mint path: hbUSDT.mint is gated by HB_USDT_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE; the only holder is Depositor 0x6261f30144b259c74243d5f5d9230941186ac936, whose deposit() is permissionless and uncapped (depositCap() = 0 disables the cap check). Parameter control: Depositor.owner() is renounced and authority() = RolesAuthority 0x6278d7d6e57db17d002bc9b13e3284f58d05099a owned by 3/5 Safe 0x582195604f449df55219d707e0b4f9bdb3095b65, the only address whose setDepositCap/setPricer/togglePaused/toggleDepositToken calls simulate successfully. Role admin: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on MidasAccessControl 0x0312a9d1ff2372ddedcbb21e4b6389afc919ac4b is held by EOA 0xd4195cf4df289a4748c1a7b6ddbe770e27ba1227, which can regrant the mint role at will. Upgrades: EIP-1967 admin = ProxyAdmin 0xbf25b58cb8dfad688f7bcb2b87d71c23a6600aac owned by OZ TimelockController 0x76613bddb3d89393b4bd70d6894b1c85f6c37d5f with getMinDelay() = 172800. The prior review's unresolved question about that owner contract is answered: it is the 2-day timelock. Note for data curation: only USDT0 is currently an enabled deposit token (isDepositToken(USDe) and isDepositToken(USR) both return false). Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: Hyperbeat's Accountable integration historically generated independent cryptographic asset-and-liability proofs at a stated 15-minute interval and included hbUSDT; the latest public timestamp located was 2026-05-18. The dashboard and discovered API endpoint returned HTTP 503 during the 2026-07-15 challenge review, so current continuous operation was not established; the historical recurring proof supports periodic reconciliation only. No exact Hyperbeat vault-issuer prudential registry entry was found.
